simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to מְכֵרָה (H4380) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-f.
simple.whyItMatters: This word is connected to the original Hebrew source text, so BibleIQ can explain it from the underlying word rather than only the English translation.
simple.summary: מְכֵרָה (mᵉkêrâh) means a sword First listed occurrence: Gen 49 5.

definitions.full: H4380. mekerah [ מְכֵרָה ] noun [feminine] probably the name of a weapon , only plural suffix מְכֵרֹתֵיהֶם חָמָס כְּלֵי Gen 49:5 weapons of violence are their ׳מ (other conjectures see in Di).
definitions.rootNote: probably from the same as 3564 in the sense of stabbing ;
